name: convention-core
description: Stack-agnostic convention machinery: rule schema, one guard engine driven by each pack's guard.json, a lint dispatcher driven by each pack's pack.json, and the scan gate. Install with at least one stack pack such as convention-swift.

gated_agents.title: Gated subagent types
gated_agents.description: Regular expression matched against a subagent's type at SubagentStop. Matching subagents cannot hand back an unscanned change. Empty (default) gates no subagent; '*' gates all except the convention scanner. The main thread is always gated at Stop.
